purpose: Frozen synthetic-only vertical-axis yaw reaction-torque checks, not aircraft identification
coefficient_provenance: Arbitrary illustrative constants chosen for synthetic testing. Neither kQ nor inertia is estimated from this aircraft, its unloaded bench recordings, current, voltage, RPM or servo ADC data.
sign_convention: Body z up, positive yaw CCW/nose left. Positive mechanical rotation magnitudes; body reaction signs for logical motors rear/front-right/front-left are [-1,+1,-1], opposite their rotor rotation.

units.acceleration_rpm_s: signed change of RPM magnitude per second
units.total_body_torque_nm: sum of aerodynamic and inertial terms over logical motors

software_guards: RPM, acceleration, age and torque limits are software-domain guards, not physical parameter or operating-envelope calibration. Each motor must be seen, fresh and valid, with accelerationValid independently true. Observer initialization/reacquisition zeros do not establish known acceleration. Any invalid motor suppresses every torque output; no partial sum.
validation_boundary: Only the portable C algebra, units, signs and software guards are checked against independent analytic synthetic truth. This is a near-vertical fixed-axis model, without servo angle, rear tilt projection, gyroscopic vector terms, vehicle motion, thrust or control allocation. No hardware or active actuator path.
